Name: Camboy Sebastian--Chinese version  Dialogue Mod
Author: Araumi7z3
Description:
Camboy Sebastian 对话模组的汉化版本
原作者：udunie      汉化作者：Araumi7z3

很高兴能汉化老师的作品，译本进行了全篇的精细翻译，有些因为语言问题不合逻辑的直译也进行了语句语义上的细微调整。
适用于1.6版本 希望大家玩的开心！

以下为原作者简介内容：

- slightly rewrites Sebastian's two heart event
- rewrites/adds new dialogue to Sebastian (mostly from 4 hearts and up)

The mod is for 1.6  and up and should work with any portrait mods, and probably with dialogue mods too, but it hasn't been tested with other stuff... I think it can work with any farmer gender, but would work best with male or gnc farmer.
